topic.title: Social
topic.shortdesc: Write once and post to several accounts of one business. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

image.alt: The Social page: the New post form with text, media and account chips, and lists of scheduled posts, recent comments and accounts.

body.p: Accounts (Instagram, Threads, X, Reddit, YouTube and Discord) are connected in Accounts. The Accounts list here shows each one's business, what it can do (publish, reply, DM) and whether its comments and messages are being watched.
Recent lists the comments, mentions and messages that came in, each linked to the task that handled it. Replies the agents draft go to Approvals like everything else.

Waiting to send appears when a Reddit account connected with your own login has approved replies, posts or messages queued: such an account sends one at a time, some minutes apart and only a few a day, so approving several at once doesn't post them all together. Each shows when it will go; Cancel stops one that hasn't gone yet.

ol.li: Give it a Title. It names the post in Approvals and is the title on Reddit and YouTube.
Write the Text, and add a Link if you want one.
Add Media: pick image or video files, or paste a public URL and choose Add.
Under Post to, pick the accounts. They must all belong to one business.

For each account, check its box: the character count against that platform's limit, a subreddit or channel where needed, and Customise text to write that platform's version. Problems such as over 280 characters or needs an image or video are listed there.
Optionally set Publish at. Empty means as soon as you approve.
Choose Send for approval, then approve it in Approvals.

body.p: Approved posts with a publish time wait here. Cancel stops one before it goes out; once published, view post opens it. A failed post shows why.
